items.evidence: theories/ExtractTradingChecked.v imports ExtrRustCheckedArith; rust/rocq_ffi/src/trading_checked.rs contains checked_add/checked_sub/checked_mul/checked_neg; python/rocq.py defaults checked=True on max_profit/max_drawdown/run_orders. New examples (Rle, ModExp, OrderFsm) are extracted checked-only (theories/Extract{Rle,ModExp,OrderFsm}.v). Safety batch (DriveModeFsm, HybridEnergyFsm, Pid, Hysteresis, Mpc, SensorFusion) extracted checked-only. SceneModel extracted checked-only. SceneWorld extracted checked-only; rocq_analyze_checked added and made the Python default. Fletcher and Rss extracted checked-only.

mp_bounded and mdd_bounded in theories/Trading.v bound the accumulators (m, b / peak, worst) by induction over the scans' own recursion, not just the results. Pid: raw_fits_i64 bounds each product and the pre-clamp sum; Mpc: mpc_cost_bounded inducts over mpc's own recursion with a recursively defined budget CB; mpc_intermediate_fits covers every candidate the minimization compares; CB_cap evaluates the budget at the enforced domain (mpc_fits_i64, mpc_intermediate_fits_i64); SensorFusion: gate_fits_i64 covers both gate additions. SceneModel: pair_arith_fits bounds every pair-rule intermediate on validated objects (validated_bounds).

safe_price_bound = 2^62-1 defined in theories/Trading.v; max_profit_fits_i64 / max_drawdown_fits_i64 closed under the global context (Print Assumptions); python/rocq.py SAFE_PRICE_BOUND mirrors it and _enforce_price_domain rejects with DomainError citing the theorem. ModExp: safe_modulus = 2^32 proved sufficient (square_fits, mixed_fits, pow_mod_lt in theories/ModExp.v), mirrored as rocq.SAFE_MODULUS and enforced with DomainError; m = 0 rejected (pow_mod_correct hypothesis). Pid: PID_GAIN_MAX/PID_ERR_MAX; Hysteresis: THERMO_T_MAX (step_fits_i64); Mpc: MPC_STATE_MAX + MPC_HORIZON_MAX backed end-to-end by mpc_fits_i64/CB_cap; SensorFusion: 2^62-1 (gate_fits_i64 — the prover rejected 2^62: f+tol could equal 2^63, one past i64::MAX). SceneWorld: SAFE_COORD = 2^62-1 (ingest_fits_i64, incl. the i64::MIN-negation margin) enforced in check_scene_world; analyze() brought in line with its component functions (price domain + gate obligation + hypotheses, checked build default). Fletcher: symbol domain [0,254] is the single_error_detected HYPOTHESIS — a property-guarding domain (0=255 mod 255), enforced with a DomainError explaining the blind spot. Rss: rss_dom enforced, rss_fits_i64 proves +-2^50.

step computes `pos + qty` before range-checking; step_fits_i64 states the extra obligation limit + max|qty| <= i64_max; enforced in python/rocq.py run_orders. Contrast case: OrderFsm's guard compares before adding (fill_add_bounded), eliminating the obligation entirely — safe for all inputs. Pid raw is computed before the output clamp — discharged by raw_fits_i64. DriveModeFsm/HybridEnergyFsm avoid Z.abs/Z.opp on raw inputs (i64::MIN would panic checked negation): two-sided compares and constant regen instead. SceneModel inverts the pattern entirely: validate-then-compute — unary rules are comparisons only (total on any i64, incl. i64::MIN), all arithmetic gated behind envelope_ok.

run_orders_within_limit assumes -lim <= pos0 <= lim; python/rocq.py rejects limit < 0 (empty interval) and initial outside [-limit, limit] with ValueError before calling native code. pow_mod: m != 0 and m <= safe_modulus enforced; run_order_events: qty >= 0 (init_run_invariant). thermo_run enforces |t0| <= 2^62 (band_invariant needs entry only for the band claim; fits needs the bound); fuse rejects empty readings (median_in_inputs hypothesis) and tol < 0. check_scene_world rejects heading outside 0..3 (egress_ingest_id hypothesis).

python/demo.py section 5: max_profit([-SAFE_PRICE_BOUND, SAFE_PRICE_BOUND]) = 9223372036854775806 matches the Python spec transliteration exactly at the proved boundary. pow_mod tested at exactly m = 2^32 (demo_more.py).

python/demo.py: 2000 random series vs naive O(n^2) spec for max_profit and max_drawdown, 2000 random order sequences vs naive gate, plus 2000 random sort lists vs sorted(); rust/trading_main.rs repeats this natively with 5000 trials. All pass as of this audit's toolchain. demo_more.py: 2000 RLE roundtrips (+ length-bound and counts-positive witnesses), 2000 pow_mod trials vs Python's pow(), 2000 adversarial FSM event streams (fills across full i64) vs reference. demo_safety.py: 2000-trial differential runs per FSM/controller (inputs across full i64 where the posture allows), MPC vs exhaustive 3^5 enumeration (300 trials), 2000 fusion scenes with minority-arbitrary faults checking majority_band and pairwise consistency at runtime. demo_scene.py: 16-object worked scene asserting every rule's verdict, 400 randomized scenes (30% fields drawn from full i64) checking check_length/score_bounds/score_le_conf/clean_confirmed/hard_env_implausible at runtime, plus an all-i64-extremes totality scene. demo_scene.py SS4-5: world-frame vs ego-frame entry-for-entry equality at a 50 km pose (egress_ingest_id exercised); bypass demos show contained panics for both the ingest subtraction overflow and the i64::MIN negation. demo_integrity.py: 2000 random single-symbol corruptions all detected; 2000 RSS situations agree EXACTLY with the float reference (division-free form is exact); 2000 monotonicity spot-checks; the bypassed 0x00/0xFF Fletcher collision exhibited.

rust/rocq_ffi/src/lib.rs wraps every call into extracted code in catch_unwind; status codes ROCQ_OK/ROCQ_ERR_NULL/ROCQ_ERR_PANIC; quiet panic hook with ROCQ_FFI_VERBOSE opt-out; demo layer-1 test observes RocqError instead of a crash.

python/rocq.py rejects float (TypeError, bool excluded via isinstance check), out-of-int64 (OverflowError); demo.py section 4 exercises all three rejections. README now documents the per-example protection matrix (layers a-d) for all 16 entry points; every rocq.py docstring states its applicable protections and theorems.
README section 'What is still trusted' names: extraction pretty-printer, remap table, FFI marshalling + ctypes packing, rustc/cargo.

residual_trusted_base.why_trusted: The erasure pipeline is verified; the final printing step is not.
residual_trusted_base.mitigation: Differential tests (layer 3); small, readable generated output.

residual_trusted_base.component: Remap table (Z -> i64, bool -> bool, Z.add -> checked_add, ...)
residual_trusted_base.why_trusted: Axiom connecting Rocq terms to Rust primitives; unprovable by construction.
residual_trusted_base.mitigation: Checked variants make width violations panic; proved domain keeps execution inside the region where the remap is faithful.

residual_trusted_base.why_trusted: Ordinary hand-written code; no theorem covers it.
residual_trusted_base.mitigation: Differential tests cross the full stack; boundary defends itself (null checks, length clamp, catch_unwind).
None beyond upstream testing; same trust as any Rust project.

known_leaks.input: max_profit([-2^62, 2^62]) — both values are legal i64
known_leaks.observed: 0 from the unchecked build (i64 wraparound), silently
known_leaks.closed_by: Layer 2 (DomainError via SAFE_PRICE_BOUND, default) and layer 1 (checked build panics -> RocqError if domain check is bypassed)

known_leaks.input: OrderFsm originally on N: `<=?` resolves to Corelib.BinNums.NatDef.N.leb, missed by the plugin's Stdlib.NArith remaps
known_leaks.observed: generated Rust fails to compile: remapped Pos.compare (a partial application in Rocq) printed with arity 0 — `this method takes 2 arguments but 0 arguments were supplied`
known_leaks.closed_by: Modeling quantities in Z (Corelib.BinNums.IntDef remap surface). Loud (build failure), not silent; recorded as a toolchain gotcha in README.

known_leaks.input: SensorFusion gate with SAFE bound 2^62 (draft value): f = tol = 2^62
known_leaks.observed: f + tol = 2^63 = i64::MAX + 1 — gate_fits_i64 unprovable; lia rejected the draft before any code shipped
known_leaks.closed_by: Bound tightened to 2^62 - 1; caught at proof time (the cheapest place to catch it)

known_leaks.input: Any scene field at i64 extremes (e.g. x = i64::MIN) — no binding-side domain exists for the scene checker
known_leaks.observed: handled: unary rules use two-sided comparisons (no Z.abs/Z.opp on raw input, which would panic checked negation at i64::MIN); pair arithmetic unreachable for unvalidated objects
known_leaks.closed_by: Architecture (validate-then-compute), proved by validated_bounds + pair_arith_fits rather than enforced at the boundary

known_leaks.input: analyze() predating the documentation pass: no domain enforcement, unchecked build only
known_leaks.observed: documentation pass (2026-07-27) found the composite entry point weaker than its parts — an L2/L1 gap, silent-wrong reachable via analyze() with extreme prices
known_leaks.closed_by: rocq_analyze_checked export added; Python analyze() now enforces the price domain, gate obligation and hypotheses, checked by default

known_leaks.input: Rss.v first draft: rho in whole seconds (integer-unit inconsistency)
known_leaks.expected: verdicts matching the physical RSS formula
known_leaks.observed: type-checked and PROVED fine — monotonicity theorems are unit-blind — but every verdict was physically wrong (80 m at 20 vs 15 m/s reported unsafe); caught by the demo's float-reference sanity check before commit
known_leaks.closed_by: rho re-unitized to deciseconds, inequality rescaled by 200*b*B; recorded in the Rss.v header as the case for keeping differential tests alongside proofs
